overlays.label: ESO VISTA · infrared, star-aligned
overlays.registrationNote: 8954 × 10000 ESO Y/J/Ks image; about 7.7° × 8.6°. Image-to-image scale, rotation and handedness fitted to 16,020 SMASH stars; 5,340 held out, P90 error 0.67 SMASH pixels (~3.3 arcsec), matched hull 83%. Corrected the publisher placement; corners outside the matched hull are extrapolated. The same saved user-authored model fit as SMASH is then applied for display, not as scientific size or simulation registration. Infrared display colors; still partial density coverage. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial; the current 3D reconstruction is unchanged.

overlays.label: Horálek · optical wide field
overlays.credit: NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/P. Horálek (Institute of Physics in Opava)
overlays.registrationNote: Measured registration to SMASH using 592 unique point sources; 198 held out of final fit, median 0.59 SMASH pixels and P90 1.12 pixels (4.996 arcsec/pixel). Homography is an approximation; validated point hull covers 60.2% of source raster, outer area extrapolated. No per-pixel distances or simulation correspondence implied. The same saved image-to-density visual fit is applied as for SMASH. Import and alignment preview only; cloud processing awaits explicit approval. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial; compact residual and diffuse light remain inspectable before a new volume bake.

overlays.label: NASA WISE · 24° infrared candidate
overlays.registrationNote: 24° NASA/IPAC WISE field rendered by CDS as W4/W2/W1 RGB, 6000 × 6000 (~14.6 arcsec/pixel). Fixed publisher WCS verified against 34,811 independently retrieved AllWISE W1 catalogue positions; 11,604 reserved checks, P90 0.632 native WISE pixels, 99.3% matched hull. No geometry correction fitted. This checks position, not diffuse photometry or visible atlas seams. The shared user-authored SMASH model fit is applied separately for display. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial.
